contract_act_s27.title: Agreements in restraint of trade
contract_act_s27.summary: Agreements that restrain a person from a lawful profession, trade or business are void to that extent (subject to the statutory exception for sale of goodwill).
contract_act_s27.verification_note: Section 27 heading and text checked against India Code; includes statutory exception concerning sale of goodwill.

contract_act_s73.title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
contract_act_s73.summary: A party suffering from a breach may claim compensation for loss that naturally arose from the breach or that the parties knew likely to result.
contract_act_s73.verification_note: Section 73 heading and text checked against India Code.

contract_act_s74.title: Compensation for breach where penalty stipulated for
contract_act_s74.summary: Where a sum is named as payable on breach, the court may award only reasonable compensation not exceeding the named amount.
contract_act_s74.verification_note: Section 74 heading and text checked against India Code.

topa_s105_111.title: Leases of immovable property
topa_s105_111.summary: Defines lease and sets rules on duration, notice to terminate and forfeiture. Check the exact notice provision and any state amendments.

registration_act_s17.title: Documents of which registration is compulsory

registration_act_s17.verification_note: Registration Act source checked; section 17 and applicable state amendments must be assessed for the instrument.

it_act_s5.title: Legal recognition of electronic signatures
it_act_s5.summary: Electronic signatures meeting the Act's requirements are legally recognised. This does not remove stamp-duty or registration requirements.
it_act_s5.verification_note: IT Act source checked including section 10A and First Schedule exclusions; e-sign eligibility remains instrument-specific.

telangana_rent_control.title: Tenancy and eviction protections
telangana_rent_control.summary: A state rent control statute may apply to the premises. Applicability, rent thresholds and eviction grounds must be confirmed from the official text.

copyright_act_s17_19.title: First ownership of copyright; assignment must be in writing
copyright_act_s17_19.summary: Section 17 deals with who first owns copyright, including works made in the course of employment. Section 19 sets formal requirements for an assignment, including writing and the rights, duration and territory covered. Confirm the exact text.

msmed_s15_16.act: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006
msmed_s15_16.title: Payment to micro and small enterprises
msmed_s15_16.summary: Sets payment time limits and interest on delayed payment for registered micro and small enterprise suppliers. Applies only if the supplier is registered; confirm applicability and the current text.

sale_goods_act_s12_17.title: Conditions and warranties; sale by description and sample
sale_goods_act_s12_17.summary: The Act distinguishes conditions and warranties and provides implied terms concerning title, description, quality/fitness and sale by sample, subject to the statutory provisions and exceptions.
